# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, multilingual online encyclopedia collaboratively edited by volunteers worldwide, operated by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Wikipedia was founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, evolving from Nupedia into the world's largest reference website. The English Wikipedia is the largest language edition, featuring millions of articles under Creative Commons licensing with collaborative editing as its core principle.

## Key Topics

- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Main article about Wikipedia, founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger
- [English Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Article about English Wikipedia edition by Wikimedia Foundation
- [History of Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Historical overview of Wikipedia's evolution from Nupedia to present
